d: We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Auction Accounts Assistant to support financial administration and accounting activities within auction operations. The successful candidate will assist with transaction processing, payment tracking, invoice preparation, and financial record management to ensure smooth and accurate auction-related financial processes.
Process and record auction-related payments and financial transactions.
Prepare invoices, receipts, payment confirmations, and account statements.
Monitor buyer payments, seller settlements, and outstanding balances.
Assist with accounts payable and accounts receivable activities.
Reconcile auction sales records with payment and accounting records.
Track auction fees, commissions, deposits, and other financial charges.
Follow up on overdue payments and investigate transaction discrepancies.
Maintain accurate financial databases and supporting documentation.
Coordinate with auction teams, buyers, and sellers on payment-related matters.
Assist with financial summaries and periodic accounting reports.
Basic knowledge of accounting principles and financial procedures.
Strong numerical skills and attention to detail.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software.
Ability to handle confidential financial information responsibly.
Reliable, systematic, and proactive working attitude.
Previous experience in accounting, finance, auction administration, or payment processing is an advantage.
A professional and supportive working environment.
Opportunities to develop accounting and financial administration skills.
Practical exposure to auction transactions and financial operations.
🚀 Accuracy in every transaction. Confidence in every account.
If you're interested in accounting and enjoy working with financial records, we'd love to hear from you!

This role is responsible for delivering exceptional customer experience within the showroom by providing professional sales consultation, promoting CEER’s products and services, and achieving individual and showroom sales targets. This role acts as the primary point of contact for retail customers, guiding them through the vehicle purchase journey from initial inquiry to deal closure.
q: Education: High School or Diploma in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
Experience: 4 Years Minimum in automotive retail sales, customer-facing roles, or a relevant field.
r: Deliver a seamless, premium end-to-end customer experience from initial inquiry through vehicle handover, acting as a trusted advisor and brand ambassador throughout the customer journey.

Lead customer engagements by identifying their needs, presenting suitable vehicles and solutions, conducting test drives, preparing quotations, negotiating terms, and closing retail sales in line with company policies.

Serve as a subject matter expert on vehicles, products, financing options, and emerging technologies, translating complex technical information into customer-centric value propositions that support informed purchase decisions.
Build and maintain long-term customer relationships, proactively managing follow-ups, referrals, repeat business opportunities, and customer retention initiatives to drive sustainable sales growth.
Ensure all customer interactions align with CEER’s brand standards and service excellence guidelines.
Achieve individual and showroom sales targets, KPIs, and conversion ratios.
Maintain accurate customer and sales pipeline data in CRM systems, ensuring timely updates, pipeline hygiene, and adherence to lead response SLAs.
Ensure all sales documentation is completed accurately and submitted timely.
Maintain high showroom presentation standards, ensuring vehicles are displayed and merchandised in line with brand and visual guidelines.
Adhere to company policies, pricing guidelines, and ethical sales practices, ensuring full compliance with regulatory requirements and internal approval processes.
Manage and convert customer leads into vehicle sales opportunities.
Promote and sell value-added products and services, including finance, insurance,
Coordinate and conduct vehicle demonstrations and test drives for qualified prospects.
